rooms.name: Victoria Platform
rooms.description: Rain and coal smoke blur the gas lamps. The Dover express waits beneath the station clock.

rooms.name: Postal Carriage
rooms.description: Canvas sacks sway in the narrow aisle. One dispatch pouch hangs open beneath the sorting shelf.

rooms.name: Guard's Van
rooms.description: A cramped van of ledgers, lamps, and sealed parcels. A heavy door connects it to the mail carriage.

rooms.name: Dining Car
rooms.description: Silver cutlery rattles on white linen. The last passengers have left their coffee untouched.

rooms.name: Conductor's Cabin
rooms.description: A narrow desk holds the route book, signal notices, and a ring of train keys.

rooms.name: Luggage Car
rooms.description: Trunks are stacked beside the sliding doors. One bears fresh brass scratches around its lock.
